title: Subsurface Permafrost Glaciers
quickFact: NASA radar detected massive sheets of pure water ice buried just 1 to 2 meters beneath Martian soil.
explore: While liquid water cannot exist on the frigid, low-pressure surface of modern Mars, enormous volumes of pure water ice are locked beneath the regolith in subsurface glaciers. The Phoenix lander used a robotic trenching arm to uncover ice chunks that vanished through sublimation over four Martian days.
nasaMission: Phoenix Mars Lander & Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (SHARAD Radar)

refinementConversion.description: Purified into sterile drinking water and electrolyzed into O2.

checkQuestion.question: What happens to exposed water ice on the surface of Mars?
options: It quickly melts into a liquid river
It turns directly from solid ice into gas (sublimates)
It combusts due to solar radiation
It stays frozen forever without changing
checkQuestion.explanation: Because Mars atmospheric pressure is only 0.6% of Earths, water cannot remain liquid and transitions directly from solid to vapor (sublimation).
